review.why: Runs evidence-based research memos with a plan, source registry, citation checks and a quality gate before delivery.
review.summary: A single-agent-first research workflow with three output sizes (brief memo, full report, delta update). It scopes the task, plans one to five threads, writes notes that separate facts from analysis, builds a source registry, checks citations with scripts, and runs an evaluator and quality gates. It records a run summary and keeps publishing out of scope.
strengths: Clear routing: lists when not to use it and defaults to the lightest output
Conflicting evidence is shown, not averaged away
Degraded mode when scripts or subagents are missing
cautions: Many artifacts and references: heavy for a small question
Source scores are heuristics, and the skill says so
Most method details sit in reference files not read here
